      DeadTime(IN := DeadTimePending AND NOT BrakeFeedback AND NOT RestartInhibit, PT := DeadTimeOppositeDir);
      DeadTimeElapsed := DeadTime.ET;
      IF DeadTime.Q THEN
          DeadTimePending := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      
      IF MotorRequest AND DeadTimePending THEN
          IF RequestedRelayFwd THEN
              NewDirection := 1;
          ELSE
              NewDirection := -1;
          END_IF;
          IF NewDirection = LastDirection THEN
              RequiredDeadTime := DeadTimeSameDir;
          ELSE
              RequiredDeadTime := DeadTimeOppositeDir;
          END_IF;
          IF DeadTime.ET >= RequiredDeadTime THEN
              DeadTimePending := FALSE;
          END_IF;
      END_IF;
      
      // â”€â”€ 5. Autorisation moteur â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
      RelayFwd := FALSE; RelayRev := FALSE;
      Contactor1 := FALSE; Contactor2 := FALSE; Contactor3 := FALSE; Contactor4 := FALSE;
      Busy := FALSE; Done := FALSE; Ready := NOT Error;
      
      IF Error THEN
          StepDelay(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1s250ms);
          StepDelayElapsed := StepDelay.ET;
          StepDelayTarget := 0;
          AuthorizedStep := 0;
          State := E_WinchFinalInterlockState.FAULT;
      ELSIF RestartInhibit THEN
          StepDelay(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1s250ms);
          StepDelayElapsed := StepDelay.ET;
          StepDelayTarget := 0;
          AuthorizedStep := 0;
          Reason := E_WinchFinalInterlockReason.RESTART_INHIBITED;
          State := E_WinchFinalInterlockState.FAULT;
      ELSIF NOT MotorRequest THEN
          // Toute annulation de demande annule la temporisation de hausse en cours.
          StepDelay(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1s250ms);
          StepDelayElapsed := StepDelay.ET;
          StepDelayTarget := 0;
          AuthorizedStep := 0;
          State := E_WinchFinalInterlockState.READY;
      ELSIF RestartRequired OR DeadTimePending THEN
          StepDelay(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1s250ms);
          StepDelayElapsed := StepDelay.ET;
          StepDelayTarget := 0;
          AuthorizedStep := 0;
          State := E_WinchFinalInterlockState.WAIT_RESTART_DELAY;
          Busy := TRUE;
      ELSE
          // âš¡ Progression de palier directe : la temporisation (tempo palier) est gÃ©rÃ©e
          // par le mÃ©tier (FB_Winch). La barriÃ¨re finale transmet directement la consigne
          // sans micro-coupure des contacteurs.
          StepDelay(IN := FALSE, PT := T#1s250ms);
          StepDelayElapsed := StepDelay.ET;
          StepDelayTarget := 0;
          AuthorizedStep := RequestedStepClamped;
      
          IF (AuthorizedStep > 0) OR (RequestedStepClamped > 0) THEN
              RelayFwd := RequestedRelayFwd;
              RelayRev := RequestedRelayRev;
              Contactor1 := RequestedContactor1;
              Contactor2 := RequestedContactor2;
              Contactor3 := RequestedContactor3;
              Contactor4 := RequestedContactor4;
          END_IF;
      
          IF NOT BrakeFeedback THEN
              State := E_WinchFinalInterlockState.WAIT_BRAKE_COMMAND_CONFIRMATION;
              Busy := TRUE;
          ELSE
              State := E_WinchFinalInterlockState.READY;
          END_IF;
      END_IF;
      
      // â”€â”€ 6. Commande frein â€” couplage direct â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
      // BrakeCmd suit STRUCTURELLEMENT RelayFwd/RelayRev, calculÃ© APRÃˆS leur
      // finalisation ci-dessus (Â§5) : il hÃ©rite donc automatiquement de toutes leurs
      // conditions de sÃ©curitÃ© (Error, RestartInhibit, RestartRequired, MotorRequest)
      // sans avoir Ã  les rÃ©pÃ©ter. Aucun risque d'Ã©cart frein/mouvement possible : le
      // frein ne PEUT pas Ãªtre commandÃ© ouvert sans qu'un des deux relais de sens le
      // soit aussi, puisque c'est la mÃªme expression. PRG_06_Outputs recalcule la
      // MÃŠME expression indÃ©pendamment sur les DQ finaux (M1RelayFwd OR M1RelayRev)
      // pour piloter physiquement la bobine â€” ce BrakeCmd ici sert de miroir/diagnostic
      // (State, IHM) mais n'est plus cÃ¢blÃ© sur la sortie physique (voir PRG_06 Â§2).
      BrakeCmd := RelayFwd OR RelayRev;
      
      // â”€â”€ 6bis. Watchdog frein : uniquement sur la commande RÃ‰ELLEMENT FINALE â”€â”€â”€â”€
      // Watchdog armÃ© sur BrakeCmd (fin Â§5/Â§6), JAMAIS sur RequestedRelayFwd/Rev (demande amont pas
      // encore autorisÃ©e par le state-machine Â§5 â€” RestartRequired peut la retenir jusqu'Ã  T#1000ms,
      // largement > le seuil 500ms ci-dessous, ce qui dÃ©clencherait un faux dÃ©faut Ã  chaque redÃ©marrage
      // normal).
      BrakeTimeout(IN := BrakeCmd AND NOT BrakeFeedback AND NOT RestartInhibit, PT := T#500ms);
      BrakeTimeoutElapsed := BrakeTimeout.ET;
      IF BrakeTimeout.Q THEN
          BrakeTimeoutCause := TRUE;
      ELSIF BrakeFeedback THEN
          BrakeTimeoutCause := FALSE;   // cause rÃ©ellement disparue (retour desserrage confirmÃ©)
      END_IF;
      BrakeTimeoutCauseEdge(CLK := BrakeTimeoutCause);
      IF BrakeTimeoutCauseEdge.Q THEN
          BrakeTimeoutAck := FALSE;    // nouvelle occurrence -> rÃ©-alarme, ack remis Ã  zÃ©ro
          RestartInhibit := TRUE;
          ResetRequired := TRUE;
          NeutralRequestSeen := FALSE;
          RestartRequired := TRUE;
          Reason := E_WinchFinalInterlockReason.BRAKE_COMMAND_NOT_CONFIRMED;
      END_IF;
      IF ResetEdge.Q THEN
          BrakeTimeoutAck := TRUE;     // toujours effectif, sans condition externe
          ResetRequired := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      IF BrakeTimeoutCause OR NOT BrakeTimeoutAck THEN
          ErrorId := ErrorId OR 16#0001;
      ELSE
          ErrorId := ErrorId AND 16#FFFE;
      END_IF;
      (* =======================================================================
         ðŸª£ FB_Bucket â€” Commande d'ouverture et de fermeture du benne
         â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
         ðŸŽ¯ RÃ´le : Pilotage synchrone et sÃ©quencement d'ouverture/fermeture benne
         ðŸ“„ Doc mÃ©tier : DOC/AF/AF_Partie-10_Fonction_Winch_v2.1.md
         ðŸ”Œ Interface : FB standard (Partie3 Â§1bis)
         ðŸ”’ SÃ©curitÃ© : Surveillance du glissement M1 et interlocks de mouvement
         ======================================================================= *)
      
      FUNCTION_BLOCK PUBLIC FB_Bucket
      VAR_INPUT
          // === COMMANDES ET ETATS GENERAL ===
          Enable                          : BOOL;                           // --> [CMD] Autorisation generale FB
          Reset                           : BOOL;                           // --> [CMD] Acquittement defauts sur front
          Mode                            : E_Mode;                         // --> [CMD] Mode de marche machine
          CmdOpen_IHM                     : BOOL;                           // --> [CMD] Demande ouverture depuis IHM
          CmdClose_IHM                    : BOOL;                           // --> [CMD] Demande fermeture depuis IHM
          MotionRequestActive             : BOOL;                           // --> [CMD] Intention mouvement arbitree
          MotionDirection                 : INT;                            // --> [CMD] Sens arbitre (1: montee, -1: descente)
          ConfirmOpenPosition             : BOOL;                           // --> [CMD] Bouton IHM confirmation benne ouvert
          ConfirmClosePosition            : BOOL;                           // --> [CMD] Bouton IHM confirmation benne ferme
      
          // === SECOURS ET HARDWARE ===
          PowerContactorEngaged           : BOOL;                           // --> [SAFE] Condition d'arret d'urgence / puissance
          CablePosM1                      : REAL;                           // --> [HW] Position reelle cable treuil M1 (m)
          CablePosM2                      : REAL;                           // --> [HW] Position reelle cable treuil M2 (m)
          HomedM1                         : BOOL;                           // --> [HW] Codeur M1 reference
          HomedM2                         : BOOL;                           // --> [HW] Codeur M2 reference
          M1_Busy                         : BOOL;                           // --> [HW] Treuil M1 en mouvement (Busy)
          M2_Busy                         : BOOL;                           // --> [HW] Treuil M2 en mouvement (Busy)
          InhibitM1                       : BOOL;                           // --> [HW] Treuil M1 inhibe
          InhibitM2                       : BOOL;                           // --> [HW] Treuil M2 inhibe
      
          // === REGLAGES ET CONFIGURATION ===
          Config                          : ST_fbBucket_Config;                // --> [CFG] Configuration parametres benne
          CfgTimeoutDuration              : TIME := T#60s;                  // --> [CFG] Timeout de mouvement configurable
          M1SlipToleranceM                : REAL := 1.0;                    // --> [CFG] Tolerance glissement M1 pendant Busy (m)
      
          // === BYPASSES ET SIMULATION ===
          BypassGlobal                    : BOOL := FALSE;                  // --> [TST] Force ErrorId=0 global
      END_VAR
      VAR_OUTPUT
          // === ETATS IEC ET SYNOPTIQUE ===
          Ready                           : BOOL;                           // <-- [STAT] FB pret a fonctionner
          ActiveOffsetValid               : BOOL;                           // <-- [STAT] Validite offset actif calcule a jour
          // ðŸ§© Statut transverse (forme cible ST_Fault + ST_Lifecycle)
          Fault                           : ST_Fault;
          Lifecycle                       : ST_Lifecycle;
      
          // === DEMANDES ET ORDRES ACTIONNEURS ===
          CloseReq                        : BOOL;                           // <-- [STAT] Demande de fermeture memorisee
          OpenReq                         : BOOL;                           // <-- [STAT] Demande d'ouverture memorisee
          M2_StartStop                    : BOOL;                           // <-- [ACT] Ordre StartStop vers Winch M2
          M2_Direction                    : INT;                            // <-- [ACT] Ordre Direction vers Winch M2
          M2_ForceSlowSpeed               : BOOL;                           // <-- [ACT] Forcage vitesse lente sur M2
      
          // === DIAGNOSTICS ET MESURES ===
          M1SlipDetected                  : BOOL;                           // <-- [DIAG] Glissement M1 detecte
          ActiveOffsetM                   : REAL;                           // <-- [DIAG] Decalage cible pour FB_WinchSync
          DeltaPosition_M                 : REAL;                           // <-- [DIAG] Ecart reel signe M2 - M1 (m)
          RemainingTravelM                : REAL;                           // <-- [DIAG] Distance restante avant cible (m)
      END_VAR
      VAR_IN_OUT
          // === STRUCTURES DE DONNÃ‰ES PARTAGÃ‰ES ===
          BucketState                     : ST_fbBucket_State;                 // <-> [BUS] Etat physique memorise du benne
      END_VAR
      VAR
          // === DETECTEURS ET TIMERS INTERNES ===
          ResetEdge                       : R_TRIG;                         // . [LOC] Detecteur front montant Reset
          BusyEdge                        : R_TRIG;                         // . [LOC] Detecteur entree en etat Busy
          ConfirmOpenEdge                 : R_TRIG;                         // . [LOC] Detecteur front confirmation ouverture
          ConfirmCloseEdge                : R_TRIG;                         // . [LOC] Detecteur front confirmation fermeture
          TonTimeout                      : TON;                            // . [LOC] Temporisateur timeout de mouvement
      
          // === VARIABLES LOCALES CALCULÃ‰ES ===
          FirstCycle                      : BOOL := TRUE;                  // . [LOC] Drapeau de premier cycle API
          SevereError                     : BOOL;                           // . [LOC] Erreur grave necessitant arret
          MaxAllowedOffset                : REAL;                           // . [LOC] Offset max calcule dynamiquement
          M1RefPosM                       : REAL;                           // . [LOC] Position M1 memorisee a l'entree Busy
          M2StartPosM                     : REAL;                           // . [LOC] Position M2 memorisee a l'entree Busy
          WasOpenAtStart                  : BOOL;                           // . [LOC] Etat IsOpen memorise a l'entree Busy
          WasClosedAtStart                : BOOL;                           // . [LOC] Etat IsClosed memorise a l'entree Busy
          LeftStartSinceArm               : BOOL;                           // . [LOC] Quitte position de depart
          HoldOffsetM                     : REAL;                           // . [LOC] Ecart reel mÃ©morise (gel en position intermediaire)
      
          // Latches dÃ©fauts
          CfgFaultLatched                 : BOOL;
          OffsetMaxFaultLatched           : BOOL;
          TimeoutFaultLatched             : BOOL;
          M1SlipFaultLatched              : BOOL;
          HomingFaultLatched              : BOOL;
      
          // Socle dÃ©faut
          instFault                       : FB_FaultCore;                   // * [INST] Socle dÃ©faut transverse
          instCauses                      : ARRAY[0..15] OF ST_FaultCause;  // . [LOC] Table des causes nommÃ©es
      END_VAR
      
      // === IMPLEMENTATION ===
      
      {region "Â§1 Causes & Socle DÃ©faut (Ã©valuÃ© en continu)"}
      // ðŸ”‘ 1. FRONTS & REARMEMENT
      ResetEdge(CLK := Reset);
      
      IF ResetEdge.Q OR BypassGlobal THEN
          CfgFaultLatched       := FALSE;
          OffsetMaxFaultLatched := FALSE;
          TimeoutFaultLatched   := FALSE;
          M1SlipFaultLatched    := FALSE;
          HomingFaultLatched    := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      
      IF NOT BypassGlobal THEN
          // Cause 0 : Configuration gÃ©omÃ©trie benne
          IF (Config.OffsetOpenM >= Config.OffsetCloseM)
             OR (Config.OffsetOpenM < 0.0) THEN
              CfgFaultLatched := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          instCauses[0].Active   := CfgFaultLatched;
          instCauses[0].Latching := TRUE;
          instCauses[0].Texte    := 'Configuration geometrie benne invalide';
      
          // Cause 1 : DÃ©passement Ã©cart max
          MaxAllowedOffset := Config.OffsetCloseM + 2.0;
          IF (CablePosM2 > (CablePosM1 + MaxAllowedOffset)) OR (CablePosM2 < CablePosM1) THEN
              OffsetMaxFaultLatched := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          instCauses[1].Active   := OffsetMaxFaultLatched;
          instCauses[1].Latching := TRUE;
          instCauses[1].Texte    := 'Depassement ecart maximum autorise benne';
      
          // Cause 2 : Timeout
          TonTimeout(IN := Lifecycle.Busy, PT := CfgTimeoutDuration);
          IF TonTimeout.Q THEN
              TimeoutFaultLatched := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          instCauses[2].Active   := TimeoutFaultLatched;
          instCauses[2].Latching := TRUE;
          instCauses[2].Texte    := 'Timeout commande deplacement benne';
      
          // Cause 3 : Glissement M1
          M1SlipDetected := Lifecycle.Busy AND (ABS(CablePosM1 - M1RefPosM) > M1SlipToleranceM);
          IF M1SlipDetected THEN
              M1SlipFaultLatched := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          instCauses[3].Active   := M1SlipFaultLatched;
          instCauses[3].Latching := TRUE;
          instCauses[3].Texte    := 'Glissement treuil M1 pendant manoeuvre benne';
      
          // Cause 4 : Non rÃ©fÃ©rencÃ©
          IF NOT HomedM1 OR NOT HomedM2 THEN
              HomingFaultLatched := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          instCauses[4].Active   := HomingFaultLatched;
          instCauses[4].Latching := TRUE;
          instCauses[4].Texte    := 'Codeurs treuils non references pour sequence benne';
      ELSE
          TonTimeout(IN := FALSE);
          M1SlipDetected := FALSE;
          instCauses[0].Active := FALSE;
          instCauses[1].Active := FALSE;
          instCauses[2].Active := FALSE;
          instCauses[3].Active := FALSE;
          instCauses[4].Active := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      
      // Appel du socle de dÃ©faut
      instFault(Enable := Enable, Reset := Reset, Causes := instCauses);
      Fault := instFault.Fault;
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§2 Gate securite"}
      // ðŸ›‘ 2. GATE
      IF NOT Enable OR NOT PowerContactorEngaged THEN
          IF Lifecycle.Busy OR CloseReq OR OpenReq THEN
              BucketState.StateIncoherent := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          Ready := FALSE;
          ActiveOffsetValid := FALSE;
          ActiveOffsetM := 0.0;
          DeltaPosition_M := 0.0;
          RemainingTravelM := 0.0;
          Lifecycle.Busy := FALSE;
          Lifecycle.Done := FALSE;
          M2_StartStop := FALSE;
          M2_Direction := 0;
          M2_ForceSlowSpeed := FALSE;
          CloseReq := FALSE;
          OpenReq := FALSE;
          RETURN;
      END_IF;
      
      Ready := Enable AND NOT Fault.Latched;
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§3 Premier cycle & recalage boutons IHM"}
      IF FirstCycle THEN
          FirstCycle := FALSE;
          IF NOT BucketState.IsOpen AND NOT BucketState.IsClosed THEN
              BucketState.StateIncoherent := TRUE;
          END_IF;
      END_IF;
      
      ConfirmOpenEdge(CLK := ConfirmOpenPosition);
      IF ConfirmOpenEdge.Q AND ((Mode = E_Mode.MAINT_N1) OR (Mode = E_Mode.MAINT_N2)) AND NOT Lifecycle.Busy THEN
          BucketState.IsOpen := TRUE;
          BucketState.IsClosed := FALSE;
          BucketState.LastPosM2Open := CablePosM2;
          BucketState.StateIncoherent := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      
      ConfirmCloseEdge(CLK := ConfirmClosePosition);
      IF ConfirmCloseEdge.Q AND ((Mode = E_Mode.MAINT_N1) OR (Mode = E_Mode.MAINT_N2)) AND NOT Lifecycle.Busy THEN
          BucketState.IsOpen := FALSE;
          BucketState.IsClosed := TRUE;
          BucketState.LastPosM2Close := CablePosM2;
          BucketState.StateIncoherent := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§4 SÃ©quencement mouvement benne"}
      SevereError := Fault.Error;
      
      IF SevereError THEN
          M2_StartStop := FALSE;
          M2_Direction := 0;
          M2_ForceSlowSpeed := FALSE;
          CloseReq := FALSE;
          OpenReq := FALSE;
          Lifecycle.Busy := FALSE;
          Lifecycle.Done := FALSE;
      ELSE
          // Prise en compte des demandes IHM â€” anti-traversÃ©e (TC-P10-025) :
          // demande benne refusÃ©e si un treuil agit (M1_Busy OR M2_Busy) Ã  l'entrÃ©e READY.
          IF CmdOpen_IHM AND NOT Lifecycle.Busy AND NOT M1_Busy AND NOT M2_Busy THEN
              OpenReq := TRUE;
              CloseReq := FALSE;
          ELSIF CmdClose_IHM AND NOT Lifecycle.Busy AND NOT M1_Busy AND NOT M2_Busy THEN
              CloseReq := TRUE;
              OpenReq := FALSE;
          END_IF;
      
          BusyEdge(CLK := (CloseReq OR OpenReq) AND MotionRequestActive);
      
          IF BusyEdge.Q THEN
              M1RefPosM := CablePosM1;
              M2StartPosM := CablePosM2;
              WasOpenAtStart := BucketState.IsOpen;
              WasClosedAtStart := BucketState.IsClosed;
              LeftStartSinceArm := FALSE;
              Lifecycle.Busy := TRUE;
              Lifecycle.Done := FALSE;
          END_IF;
      
          IF Lifecycle.Busy THEN
              IF CloseReq THEN
                  RemainingTravelM := MAX(0.0, (CablePosM1 + Config.OffsetCloseM) - CablePosM2);
                  M2_ForceSlowSpeed := TRUE;
                  IF MotionRequestActive AND (MotionDirection = 1) THEN
                      M2_StartStop := TRUE;
                      M2_Direction := 1;
                  ELSIF MotionRequestActive AND (MotionDirection = -1) THEN
                      M2_StartStop := TRUE;
                      M2_Direction := -1;
                  ELSE
                      M2_StartStop := FALSE;
                      M2_Direction := 0;
                  END_IF;
              ELSIF OpenReq THEN
                  RemainingTravelM := MAX(0.0, CablePosM2 - (CablePosM1 + Config.OffsetOpenM));
                  M2_ForceSlowSpeed := TRUE;
                  IF MotionRequestActive AND (MotionDirection = -1) THEN
                      M2_StartStop := TRUE;
                      M2_Direction := -1;
                  ELSIF MotionRequestActive AND (MotionDirection = 1) THEN
                      M2_StartStop := TRUE;
                      M2_Direction := 1;
                  ELSE
                      M2_StartStop := FALSE;
                      M2_Direction := 0;
                  END_IF;
              ELSE
                  M2_StartStop := FALSE;
                  M2_Direction := 0;
                  M2_ForceSlowSpeed := FALSE;
              END_IF;
      
              IF (CloseReq AND (CablePosM2 > M2StartPosM)) OR (OpenReq AND (CablePosM2 < M2StartPosM)) THEN
                  LeftStartSinceArm := TRUE;
              END_IF;
      
              // ArrÃªt fermeture
              IF CloseReq THEN
                  IF CablePosM2 >= (CablePosM1 + Config.OffsetCloseM - Config.CloseAnticipationM) THEN
                      M2_StartStop := FALSE;
                      M2_Direction := 0;
                      BucketState.IsOpen := FALSE;
                      BucketState.IsClosed := TRUE;
                      BucketState.LastPosM2Close := CablePosM2;
                      BucketState.StateIncoherent := FALSE;
                      CloseReq := FALSE;
                      Lifecycle.Busy := FALSE;
                      Lifecycle.Done := TRUE;
                  ELSIF LeftStartSinceArm AND (CablePosM2 <= M2StartPosM) THEN
                      M2_StartStop := FALSE;
                      M2_Direction := 0;
                      BucketState.IsOpen := WasOpenAtStart;
                      BucketState.IsClosed := WasClosedAtStart;
                      CloseReq := FALSE;
                      Lifecycle.Busy := FALSE;
                      Lifecycle.Done := TRUE;
                  END_IF;
              END_IF;
      
              // ArrÃªt ouverture
              IF OpenReq THEN
                  IF CablePosM2 <= (CablePosM1 + Config.OffsetOpenM + Config.OpenAnticipationM) THEN
                      M2_StartStop := FALSE;
                      M2_Direction := 0;
                      BucketState.IsOpen := TRUE;
                      BucketState.IsClosed := FALSE;
                      BucketState.LastPosM2Open := CablePosM2;
                      BucketState.StateIncoherent := FALSE;
                      OpenReq := FALSE;
                      Lifecycle.Busy := FALSE;
                      Lifecycle.Done := TRUE;
                  ELSIF LeftStartSinceArm AND (CablePosM2 >= M2StartPosM) THEN
                      M2_StartStop := FALSE;
                      M2_Direction := 0;
                      BucketState.IsOpen := WasOpenAtStart;
                      BucketState.IsClosed := WasClosedAtStart;
                      OpenReq := FALSE;
                      Lifecycle.Busy := FALSE;
                      Lifecycle.Done := TRUE;
                  END_IF;
              END_IF;
          ELSIF Lifecycle.Done THEN
              M2_StartStop := FALSE;
              M2_Direction := 0;
              M2_ForceSlowSpeed := FALSE;
              RemainingTravelM := 0.0;
              IF NOT MotionRequestActive THEN
                  Lifecycle.Done := FALSE;
              END_IF;
          END_IF;
      END_IF;
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§5 Offset actif et validite"}
      DeltaPosition_M := CablePosM2 - CablePosM1;
      
      IF Lifecycle.Busy THEN
          ActiveOffsetM := CablePosM2 - CablePosM1;
          HoldOffsetM := ActiveOffsetM;
      ELSIF CloseReq OR BucketState.IsClosed THEN
          ActiveOffsetM := Config.OffsetCloseM;
          HoldOffsetM := ActiveOffsetM;
      ELSIF OpenReq OR BucketState.IsOpen THEN
          ActiveOffsetM := Config.OffsetOpenM;
          HoldOffsetM := ActiveOffsetM;
      ELSE
          ActiveOffsetM := HoldOffsetM;
      END_IF;
      
      ActiveOffsetValid := Enable AND PowerContactorEngaged
                           AND NOT BucketState.StateIncoherent
                           AND (Fault.ErrorId = 16#0000);
      BucketState.ActiveOffsetValid := ActiveOffsetValid;
      {endregion}
      
      END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
      (* â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
         ðŸª PRG_04_Treuils_Benne â€” Commande des Treuils M1 (moteur de retenue) / M2 (moteur Benne), Synchro et Benne
         â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
         âš™ï¸ ExÃ©cutÃ© par la tÃ¢che PLC en position 4 (aprÃ¨s PRG_03_Modes_Cycle).
         âœ… Arbitre entre les commandes Manuelles (Joystick) et Automatiques (PRG_03_Modes_Cycle).
         ðŸ“„ Docs : DOC/AF/AF_Partie-10_Fonction_Winch_v2.1.md ; DOC/AF/AF_Partie-10_Fonction_Winch/FB_Bucket_v1.0.md
         â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â• *)
      
      PROGRAM PRG_04_Treuils_Benne
      
      VAR_INPUT
          // === ðŸ“¥ ENTRÃ‰ES PROGRAMME (AUCUNE - PILOTÃ‰ VIA PRG_02 & PRG_03) ===
      END_VAR
      
      VAR_OUTPUT
          // === ðŸšŒ BUS INTER-PRG (producteur unique) ===
          Data : ST_WinchInterPrg; // <-- [BUS] Demandes finales, Ã©tats, sÃ©curitÃ©s, synchro, benne
      END_VAR
      
      VAR
          instWinchSync : FB_WinchSync;
          instBucket   : FB_Bucket;
          instSafetyWinchM1 : FB_Safety_Winch;   // SÃ©curitÃ© treuil M1 (SafeStop / permits / PowerCutOff)
          instSafetyWinchM2 : FB_Safety_Winch;
          instWinchM1   : FB_Winch;
          instWinchM2   : FB_Winch;
      
          // === ðŸ“Š STRUCTS INTERNES (publiÃ©s via Data) ===
          WinchM1FinalInterlockRequest : ST_WinchFinalInterlockRequest; // . [LOC] Demande finale et interlocks treuil M1
          WinchM2FinalInterlockRequest : ST_WinchFinalInterlockRequest; // . [LOC] Demande finale et interlocks treuil M2
          KoboldContactorCmdArbitrated : BOOL;                         // . [LOC] Ordre contacteur capteur fond Kobold
          WinchM1State                 : ST_WinchState;                // . [LOC] Etat public treuil Retenue M1
          WinchM2State                 : ST_WinchState;                // . [LOC] Etat public treuil Benne M2
          WinchM1Safety                : ST_SafetyWinch;               // . [LOC] Diagnostic et securites treuil M1
          WinchM2Safety                : ST_SafetyWinch;               // . [LOC] Diagnostic et securites treuil M2
          SyncState                    : ST_SyncState;                 // . [LOC] Etat synchronisation treuils M1/M2
          BucketState                  : ST_BucketHMIState;            // . [LOC] Etat de fonctionnement benne
          Benne_IsRoughlyClosed        : BOOL;                         // . [LOC] Benne consideree fermee
          ArmingPermit                 : BOOL;                         // . [LOC] Permission d'armement homme-mort (combinÃ© interlock benne, Option B)
      
          CoupledUserRequestActive : BOOL;
          CoupledUserRequestDirection     : INT;
          ManualBottomPositionConfirmed  : BOOL;
          BottomPositionConfirmed        : BOOL;
          CmdBucketCloseArbitrated       : BOOL;
      
          // SÃ©quencement automatique benne en pilotage couplÃ© (both) normal --
          // descente uniquement benne ouverte, montÃ©e uniquement benne
          // fermÃ©e. Distinct de DumpAtTremie/DiveSearch/ExtractionSequence (fonctionnement normal,
          // pas une assistance MAINT_N1/N2 dÃ©diÃ©e). RÃ©utilise CoupledUserRequestActive/
          // CoupledUserRequestDirection (Â§1 ci-dessus) : dÃ©jÃ  exactement "mouvement couplÃ© (both)
          // demandÃ©" dans les 2 modes (joystick Select=0, ou BtnWinchBothUp/Down) â€” mÃªmes variables
          // dÃ©jÃ  utilisÃ©es par instBucket/instDiveSearch/instExtractionSequence.
          CoupledDiveBucketOpenArmed     : BOOL;  // CmdOpen_IHM dÃ©clenchÃ© par ce mÃ©canisme (diagnostic IHM)
          CoupledMotionBlockedByBucket   : BOOL;  // Garde-fou direct -- voir Â§3
          CoupledAscentBucketCloseArmed  : BOOL;  // CmdClose_IHM dÃ©clenchÃ© par ce mÃ©canisme (diagnostic IHM)
          BucketBusyRiseEdge             : R_TRIG; // DÃ©tecte le dÃ©but d'une action benne (Busy montÃ©)
          BucketBusyFallEdge             : F_TRIG; // DÃ©tecte la fin d'une action benne (Busy retombÃ©)
          ControlAscentArmedForThisClose : BOOL;   // MÃ©morise si LA fermeture en cours a Ã©tÃ© armÃ©e par ce mÃ©canisme
          ControlAscentActive            : BOOL;   // Phase vitesse contrÃ´lÃ©e en cours (diagnostic IHM)
          ControlAscentStartM1PosM       : REAL;
          ControlAscentStartM2PosM       : REAL;
      
          M1LogicRequestStartStop     : BOOL;
          M1LogicRequestDirection     : INT;
          M1LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct      : REAL;
      
          M2LogicRequestStartStop     : BOOL;
          M2LogicRequestDirection     : INT;
          M2LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct      : REAL;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive : ST_SpeedStepTable;
      
          SpeedGuardEnableM1 : BOOL := FALSE;
          SpeedGuardEnableM2 : BOOL := FALSE;
      
          BottomLimitM1_Active    : REAL;
          BottomLimitM2_Active    : REAL;
      
          CableLimitAscentM1Reached : BOOL;
          CableLimitAscentM2Reached : BOOL;
      
          SafeStopM1_Raw          : BOOL;
          SafeStopM2_Raw          : BOOL;
          SafeStopM1_Active       : BOOL;
          SafeStopM2_Active       : BOOL;
          // Taxonomie permit (D-P1 Ã  D-P11) : SafetyPermit (safety pure), ProcessPermit (process pur),
          // ProcessAndSafetyPermit (= Safety AND Process), EffectivePermit (= couplage synchro).
          SafetyPermitM1_Descend   : BOOL;
          SafetyPermitM2_Descend   : BOOL;
          SafetyPermitM1_Ascent    : BOOL;
          SafetyPermitM2_Ascent    : BOOL;
          ProcessPermitM1_Descend  : BOOL;
          ProcessPermitM2_Descend  : BOOL;
          ProcessPermitM1_Ascent   : BOOL;
          ProcessPermitM2_Ascent   : BOOL;
          ProcessAndSafetyPermitM1_Descend : BOOL;
          ProcessAndSafetyPermitM2_Descend : BOOL;
          ProcessAndSafetyPermitM1_Ascent  : BOOL;
          ProcessAndSafetyPermitM2_Ascent  : BOOL;
          EffectivePermitM1_Descend : BOOL;
          EffectivePermitM2_Descend : BOOL;
          EffectivePermitM1_Ascent  : BOOL;
          EffectivePermitM2_Ascent  : BOOL;
      
          BenneBusyFallEdge     : F_TRIG;
      
          // ArrÃªt auto descente sur dÃ©tection fond Kobold (pilotage normal)
          KoboldAutoStopRiseEdge  : R_TRIG;
          KoboldAutoStopFallEdge  : F_TRIG;
          KoboldImmersionConfirmed: BOOL;
          KoboldBottomTouchLatched: BOOL;
          DescendPermitDiveBucketOpen : BOOL; // mode Dive actif + benne ouverte = descente permise
          // pilotage unitaire M2 "sÃ©curisÃ©" -- bornes ouvert/fermÃ© + palier 1
          ManualBucketLimitsActive : BOOL;
          SlackCableAscentStep1    : BOOL; // mou de cÃ¢ble en rÃ©cupÃ©ration -- bride la montÃ©e au Palier 1
          BucketNotClosedAscentStep1 : BOOL; // benne non fermÃ©e Ã  100% Ã  la montÃ©e -- bride la montÃ©e au Palier 1
      
          // Bypass simplifiÃ© sÃ©quence FB_DiveSearch -- front montant
          // Kobold pendant une descente couplÃ©e confirme directement le fond, sans passer par les
          // prÃ©conditions strictes de FB_DiveSearch (benne ouverte, DiveStartMin_M, fenÃªtre immersion).
          // FB_DiveSearch continue de tourner en parallÃ¨le (KoboldMeasureEnable toujours cÃ¢blÃ©
          // dessus) -- ce bypass est un chemin ADDITIONNEL, pas un remplacement.
          BypassKoboldFallEdge       : F_TRIG; // front descendant Kobold
          BypassKoboldBottomTouched  : BOOL;
      
          SyncMinorDeviation      : BOOL;
          SyncMinorDeviationBlocksUp   : BOOL;
          SyncMinorDeviationBlocksDown : BOOL;
          M2_LimitShift                : REAL;
      
          EffectiveMaxStepAscent    : INT;
          EffectiveMaxStepDescente  : INT;
      
          // MÃ©moire scan prÃ©cÃ©dent pour SpeedDelta_Mps (IHM)
          M1_PrevSpeed_Mps : REAL;
          M2_PrevSpeed_Mps : REAL;
      END_VAR
      
      {region "Â§1 Intention maintenance et assistants"}
      // === ðŸª¨ Â§1 INTENTION MAINTENANCE & ASSISTANTS ===
      
      // Consommation de l'intention couplÃ©e continue opÃ©rateur (cerveau unique PRG_03, tous modes)
      CoupledUserRequestActive    := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.OperatorCoupledIntent.Active;
      CoupledUserRequestDirection := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.OperatorCoupledIntent.Direction;
      
      // RÃ©cupÃ©ration de l'Ã©tat fond synthÃ©tisÃ© par PRG_03
      BottomPositionConfirmed := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.SequenceState.BottomTouchConfirmed;
      
      // RÃ¨gle absolue en pilotage couplÃ© (both) normal --
      // descente autorisÃ©e UNIQUEMENT benne ouverte, montÃ©e UNIQUEMENT benne fermÃ©e.
      CoupledDiveBucketOpenArmed := GVL_IHM.Commun.Cfg.TglEnableCoupledBucketSequencing
          AND (PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode <> E_Mode.SEMI_AUTO)
          AND CoupledUserRequestActive AND (CoupledUserRequestDirection = -1)
          AND NOT _BucketState.IsOpen;
      CoupledAscentBucketCloseArmed := GVL_IHM.Commun.Cfg.TglEnableCoupledBucketSequencing
          AND (PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode <> E_Mode.SEMI_AUTO)
          AND CoupledUserRequestActive AND (CoupledUserRequestDirection = 1)
          AND NOT _BucketState.IsClosed;
      
      // Arbitrage de fermeture benne (CmdBucketCloseArbitrated)
      IF PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.ReqBucket.ReqClose THEN
          CmdBucketCloseArbitrated := TRUE;
      ELSIF CoupledAscentBucketCloseArmed THEN
          CmdBucketCloseArbitrated := TRUE;
      ELSE
          CmdBucketCloseArbitrated := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bucket.Cmd.BtnClose;
      END_IF;
      
      // Arbitrage contacteur Kobold (KoboldContactorCmdArbitrated)
      KoboldContactorCmdArbitrated := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.ReqBucket.ReqKoboldMeasureEnable;
      
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§2 Commande benne"}
      // === ðŸ—ï¸ Â§2 COMMANDE DU BENNE (FB_Bucket) ===
      
      instBucket(
          Enable              := NOT PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.InhibitM2,
          Reset               := PRG_07_Supervision.FaultMachineReset_IHM,
          PowerContactorEngaged     := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Machine.PowerContactorEngaged_DI,
          Mode                := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode,
          CmdOpen_IHM         := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bucket.Cmd.BtnOpen OR CoupledDiveBucketOpenArmed
                                 OR PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.ReqBucket.ReqOpen,
          CmdClose_IHM        := CmdBucketCloseArbitrated,
          MotionRequestActive := CoupledUserRequestActive,
          MotionDirection     := CoupledUserRequestDirection,
          CablePosM1          := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM,
          CablePosM2          := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.CablePosM,
          HomedM1             := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM1.Homed,
          HomedM2             := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM2.Homed,
          M1_Busy             := (instWinchM1.StepNumber > 0),
          M2_Busy             := (instWinchM2.StepNumber > 0),
          ConfirmOpenPosition := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bucket.Cmd.BtnConfirmOpenPos,
          ConfirmClosePosition:= GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bucket.Cmd.BtnConfirmClosePos,
          Config              := _BucketCfgPersist.Config,
          CfgTimeoutDuration     := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bucket.Cfg.CfgTimeoutDuration,
          BucketState        := _BucketState,
          InhibitM1           := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.InhibitM1,
          InhibitM2           := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.InhibitM2,
          BypassGlobal        := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bucket.Bypass.Global
      );
      
      // Auto-sÃ©quencement benne & DÃ©gradation Palier 1
      // Si la benne est en cours de fermeture/ouverture (instBucket.Busy), le mouvement couplÃ© attend.
      // Si la benne n'est pas fermÃ©e (NOT IsClosed) et que instBucket n'est plus occupÃ© (Busy=FALSE),
      // toute demande de montÃ©e est automatiquement dÃ©gradÃ©e au Palier 1 (Vitesse lente, voir instWinchM1/M2),
      // protÃ©geant ainsi la mÃ©canique mÃªme en pilotage unitaire ou si l'auto-sÃ©quencement est dÃ©sactivÃ©.
      // ðŸ“Œ Note d'architecture (lag 1 scan) : M1/M2LogicRequestDirection est consommÃ© ici avant son calcul arbitrÃ©
      // en Â§3 (lag d'un cycle automate nominal, tolÃ©rÃ© et homogÃ¨ne avec les arbitrages Translation/Modes).
      CoupledMotionBlockedByBucket := CoupledDiveBucketOpenArmed AND NOT instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy;
      BucketNotClosedAscentStep1 := (M1LogicRequestDirection = 1 OR M2LogicRequestDirection = 1) AND NOT instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy AND NOT _BucketState.IsClosed;
      
      // En mode rÃ©cupÃ©ration (SyncEnable=FALSE), si un mou de cÃ¢ble est dÃ©tectÃ© (bit3 ErrorId),
      // la montÃ©e/enroulement est autorisÃ©e mais bridÃ©e au Palier 1 pour retendre le tambour en sÃ©curitÃ©.
      // ðŸ“Œ Note d'architecture (lag 1 scan) : instSafetyWinchM1/M2.ErrorId est consommÃ© ici avant l'exÃ©cution du FB
      // au Â§5bis (lag d'un cycle automate nominal, sÃ©curisÃ© en amont par la lecture directe de M2_TensionedCable_DI).
      SlackCableAscentStep1 := NOT PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.SyncEnable AND (
          ((instSafetyWinchM1.Fault.ErrorId AND 16#0008) <> 16#0000) OR
          ((instSafetyWinchM2.Fault.ErrorId AND 16#0008) <> 16#0000) OR
          (NOT PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M2_TensionedCable_DI)
      );
      
      SyncMinorDeviation := (instWinchSync.Fault.ErrorId AND 16#0001) <> 16#0000;
      SyncMinorDeviationBlocksUp   := _SyncSoftStopEnable AND SyncMinorDeviation AND (instWinchSync.SignedDeltaPosM > 0.0);
      SyncMinorDeviationBlocksDown := _SyncSoftStopEnable AND SyncMinorDeviation AND (instWinchSync.SignedDeltaPosM < 0.0);
      
      IF _CommunCfgPersist.WinchMaxStepAscent <= 0 THEN
          EffectiveMaxStepAscent := 5;
      ELSE
          EffectiveMaxStepAscent := _CommunCfgPersist.WinchMaxStepAscent;
      END_IF;
      
      IF _CommunCfgPersist.WinchMaxStepDescente <= 0 THEN
          EffectiveMaxStepDescente := 3;
      ELSE
          EffectiveMaxStepDescente := _CommunCfgPersist.WinchMaxStepDescente;
      END_IF;
      
      
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§3 Arbitrage consignes M1/M2"}
      // === ðŸ”€ Â§3 ARBITRAGE CONSIGNES M1 / M2 ===
      
      IF PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode = E_Mode.SEMI_AUTO THEN
          // Pont SEMI_AUTO : consomme les demandes du sÃ©quenceur de cycle.
          // FB_Cycle produit dÃ©jÃ  StartStop conditionnÃ© par CycleMotionPermit (homme-mort 3s, D2).
          M1LogicRequestDirection := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.ReqWinchM1.ReqDirection;
          M1LogicRequestStartStop := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.ReqWinchM1.ReqStartStop;
          M1LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.ReqWinchM1.SpeedTgtPct;
      ELSE
          IF NOT GVL_IHM.Modes.Cmd.TglJoystickMaster THEN
              // Mode Boutons IHM
              IF GVL_IHM.Commun.BtnWinchBothUp OR GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Cmd.BtnUp THEN
                  M1LogicRequestDirection := 1;
                  M1LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := 100.0;
              ELSIF GVL_IHM.Commun.BtnWinchBothDown OR GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Cmd.BtnDown THEN
                  M1LogicRequestDirection := -1;
                  M1LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := 100.0;
              ELSE
                  M1LogicRequestDirection := 0;
                  M1LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := 0.0;
              END_IF;
          ELSE
              // Mode Joystick MaÃ®tre
              IF (PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.JoystickWinchSelectArbitrated = 0 OR PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.JoystickWinchSelectArbitrated = 1) THEN
                  M1LogicRequestDirection := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Joystick.AxisY.Direction;
                  M1LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := ABS(PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Joystick.AxisY.SpeedTgt);
              ELSE
                  M1LogicRequestDirection := 0;
                  M1LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := 0.0;
              END_IF;
          END_IF;
      
          M1LogicRequestStartStop := (M1LogicRequestDirection <> 0) AND NOT instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy
                                  AND NOT CoupledMotionBlockedByBucket
                                  AND NOT ((SyncMinorDeviationBlocksUp   AND (M1LogicRequestDirection = 1))
                                       OR  (SyncMinorDeviationBlocksDown AND (M1LogicRequestDirection = -1)))
                                  AND (NOT GVL_IHM.Modes.Cmd.TglJoystickMaster OR PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.JoystickDeadmanArmed);
      END_IF;
      
      // Condition renforcÃ©e "instBucket.Busy AND instBucket.M2_StartStop" au lieu de
      // "instBucket.Busy" seul : si le mouvement couplÃ© est toujours demandÃ©, M2
      // reÃ§oit sa commande de continuitÃ© le MÃŠME scan, sans dÃ©pendre d'un timing de bascule.
      IF instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy AND instBucket.M2_StartStop THEN
          M2LogicRequestStartStop := instBucket.M2_StartStop;
          M2LogicRequestDirection := instBucket.M2_Direction;
          M2LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := 15.0;
      ELSE
          IF PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode = E_Mode.SEMI_AUTO THEN
              // Pont SEMI_AUTO : consomme les demandes du sÃ©quenceur de cycle.
              M2LogicRequestDirection := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.ReqWinchM2.ReqDirection;
              M2LogicRequestStartStop := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.ReqWinchM2.ReqStartStop;
              M2LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.ReqWinchM2.SpeedTgtPct;
          ELSE
              IF NOT GVL_IHM.Modes.Cmd.TglJoystickMaster THEN
                  // Mode Boutons IHM
                  IF GVL_IHM.Commun.BtnWinchBothUp OR GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Cmd.BtnUp THEN
                      M2LogicRequestDirection := 1;
                      M2LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := 100.0;
                  ELSIF GVL_IHM.Commun.BtnWinchBothDown OR GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Cmd.BtnDown THEN
                      M2LogicRequestDirection := -1;
                      M2LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := 100.0;
                  ELSE
                      M2LogicRequestDirection := 0;
                      M2LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := 0.0;
                  END_IF;
              ELSE
                  // Mode Joystick MaÃ®tre
                  IF (PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.JoystickWinchSelectArbitrated = 0 OR PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.JoystickWinchSelectArbitrated = 2) THEN
                      M2LogicRequestDirection := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Joystick.AxisY.Direction;
                      M2LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := ABS(PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Joystick.AxisY.SpeedTgt);
                  ELSE
                      M2LogicRequestDirection := 0;
                      M2LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct  := 0.0;
                  END_IF;
              END_IF;
      
              M2LogicRequestStartStop := (M2LogicRequestDirection <> 0)
                                      AND NOT CoupledMotionBlockedByBucket
                                      AND NOT ((SyncMinorDeviationBlocksUp   AND (M2LogicRequestDirection = -1))
                                           OR  (SyncMinorDeviationBlocksDown AND (M2LogicRequestDirection = 1)))
                                      AND (NOT GVL_IHM.Modes.Cmd.TglJoystickMaster OR PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.JoystickDeadmanArmed);
          END_IF;
      END_IF;
      
      // Ne force plus l'arrÃªt si un mouvement couplÃ© est toujours activement demandÃ©
      // (CoupledUserRequestActive), auquel cas l'arbitrage normal (Â§3) prend le
      // relais sans interruption. Comportement inchangÃ© pour toute fin d'action benne SANS mouvement
      // couplÃ© en cours (ouverture/fermeture manuelle isolÃ©e, bouton IHM) : l'arrÃªt reste forcÃ©.
      BenneBusyFallEdge(CLK := instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy);
      IF BenneBusyFallEdge.Q AND NOT (CoupledUserRequestActive AND (CoupledUserRequestDirection <> 0)) THEN
          M1LogicRequestStartStop := FALSE;
          M2LogicRequestStartStop := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      
      // AprÃ¨s une fermeture benne armÃ©e PAR CE mÃ©canisme
      // (pas ExtractionSequence, qui a dÃ©jÃ  sa propre phase CONTROL_ASCENT), la montÃ©e couplÃ©e qui
      // enchaÃ®ne dÃ©marre en vitesse contrÃ´lÃ©e (palier 1) sur ExtractionControlDistance_M avant de
      // repasser en paliers normaux.
      BucketBusyRiseEdge(CLK := instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy);
      IF BucketBusyRiseEdge.Q THEN
          ControlAscentArmedForThisClose := CoupledAscentBucketCloseArmed;
      END_IF;
      IF BucketBusyFallEdge.Q AND ControlAscentArmedForThisClose THEN
          ControlAscentActive := TRUE;
          ControlAscentStartM1PosM := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM;
          ControlAscentStartM2PosM := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.CablePosM;
      END_IF;
      IF ControlAscentActive THEN
          IF (ABS(PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM - ControlAscentStartM1PosM) >= GVL_IHM.DredgingAssist.Cfg.ExtractionControlDistance_M)
             AND (ABS(PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.CablePosM - ControlAscentStartM2PosM) >= GVL_IHM.DredgingAssist.Cfg.ExtractionControlDistance_M) THEN
              ControlAscentActive := FALSE;             // Distance de contrÃ´le parcourue : paliers normaux
          ELSIF NOT (CoupledUserRequestActive AND (CoupledUserRequestDirection = 1)) THEN
              ControlAscentActive := FALSE;             // MontÃ©e relÃ¢chÃ©e/interrompue : annule la phase
          END_IF;
      END_IF;
      
      
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§3bis ArmingPermit (Option B)"}
      // === ðŸ›¡ï¸ Â§3bis ARMINGPERMIT (Option B â€” combinÃ© interlock benne) ===
      // ArmingPermit = permission d'armement homme-mort (entrÃ©e FB_Joystick, consommÃ©e PRG_02).
      // CombinÃ© interlock benne : interdit l'armement pendant une action benne
      // (ouverture/fermeture, instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy) et pendant 1 scan aprÃ¨s la fin
      // de l'action (BenneBusyFallEdge.Q, dÃ©jÃ  cÃ¢blÃ© Â§3) â€” l'opÃ©rateur doit re-presser
      // consciemment le bouton homme-mort (pas de rÃ©-armement "surprise" Ã  la rÃ©-acquisition).
      // DÃ©lai fin de cycle benne â†’ rÃ©-armement autorisÃ© : 1 scan MainTask = 10 ms
      // (dans la fenÃªtre 10-20 ms exigÃ©e). PolaritÃ© positive (NC-100) : TRUE = armement autorisÃ©.
      ArmingPermit := NOT instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy AND NOT BenneBusyFallEdge.Q;
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§4 Synchronisation M1/M2"}
      // === ðŸ”„ Â§4 SYNCHRONISATION M1 / M2 ===
      
      instWinchSync(
          Enable          := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.SyncEnable AND NOT instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy
                              AND NOT PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.InhibitM1 AND NOT PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.InhibitM2,
          Reset           := PRG_07_Supervision.FaultMachineReset_IHM,
          Mode            := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode,
          CablePosM1      := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM,
          CablePosM2      := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.CablePosM,
          HomedAndReliableM1 := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.M1_HomedAndReliable,
          HomedAndReliableM2 := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.M2_HomedAndReliable,
          SyncEnable      := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.SyncEnable,
          CfgSyncToleranceM  := _SyncCfgPersist.CfgSyncTolerance_M,
          CfgSyncCriticalToleranceM := _SyncCfgPersist.CfgSyncCriticalTolerance_M,
          ActiveOffsetM   := instBucket.ActiveOffsetM,
          RelayFwdM1      := instWinchM1.RelayFwd,
          RelayFwdM2      := instWinchM2.RelayFwd,
          RelayRevM1      := instWinchM1.RelayRev,
          RelayRevM2      := instWinchM2.RelayRev,
          Contactor1_M1   := instWinchM1.Contactor1,
          Contactor1_M2   := instWinchM2.Contactor1,
          Contactor2_M1   := instWinchM1.Contactor2,
          Contactor2_M2   := instWinchM2.Contactor2,
          Contactor3_M1   := instWinchM1.Contactor3,
          Contactor3_M2   := instWinchM2.Contactor3,
          Contactor4_M1   := instWinchM1.Contactor4,
          Contactor4_M2   := instWinchM2.Contactor4,
          BypassGlobal    := GVL_IHM.M1M2Sync.Bypass.Global
      );
      
      IF instBucket.M2_ForceSlowSpeed THEN
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P1R1 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R1;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P1R2 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R2;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P1R3 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R3;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P1R4 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R4;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P2R1 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R1;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P2R2 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R2;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P2R3 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R3;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P2R4 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R4;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P3R1 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R1;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P3R2 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R2;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P3R3 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R3;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P3R4 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R4;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P4R1 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R1;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P4R2 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R2;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P4R3 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R3;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P4R4 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R4;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P5R1 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R1;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P5R2 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R2;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P5R3 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R3;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.P5R4 := _WinchSpeedStepTable.P1R4;
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive.StepThreshold_Pct := _WinchSpeedStepTable.StepThreshold_Pct;
      ELSE
          M2_SpeedStepTableActive := _WinchSpeedStepTable;
      END_IF;
      
      
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§5 Couplage croise et securites"}
      // === ðŸ›‘ Â§5 COUPLAGE CROISÃ‰ & SÃ‰CURITÃ‰S ===
      
      // La limite lÃ©gale (profondeur min. autorisÃ©e) doit elle aussi
      // bÃ©nÃ©ficier du ralentissement progressif avant arrÃªt (comme la limite cÃ¢ble physique), pas juste
      // un arrÃªt sec (DescendPermit). Comme les 2 limites bornent la mÃªme
      // direction (descente), on alimente FB_Winch.BottomLimitM avec la PLUS RESTRICTIVE des deux
      // (MAX de 2 valeurs nÃ©gatives = celle la moins profonde = atteinte en premier) : le ralentissement
      // (FB_Winch Â§"RALENTISSEMENT AUTOMATIQUE SUR BORDURES") s'enclenche alors sur la bonne limite,
      // lÃ©gale ou cÃ¢ble, sans dupliquer le mÃ©canisme.
      IF _CommunCfgPersist.LimitLegalEnabled THEN
          BottomLimitM1_Active := MAX(_WinchM1CfgPersist.CfgCableLimitDescent_M, _CommunCfgPersist.LimitLegalDepthMinAllowed_M);
          BottomLimitM2_Active := MAX(_WinchM2CfgPersist.CfgCableLimitDescent_M, _CommunCfgPersist.LimitLegalDepthMinAllowed_M);
      ELSE
          BottomLimitM1_Active := _WinchM1CfgPersist.CfgCableLimitDescent_M;
          BottomLimitM2_Active := _WinchM2CfgPersist.CfgCableLimitDescent_M;
      END_IF;
      
      // ðŸ©º InputModuleFault (AF06 Â§3bis) : un module DI TOR hors service rend indisponibles
      // les retours frein/thermique/contacteurs/fin de course des DEUX treuils (VH_0800END,
      // Local_Digital_IO) â€” pas de granularitÃ© par treuil possible, donc SafeStop des DEUX.
      SafeStopM1_Raw      := ((instWinchSync.Fault.ErrorId AND 16#0002) <> 16#0000) OR instBucket.M1SlipDetected OR PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.InputModuleFault;
      SafeStopM2_Raw      := ((instWinchSync.Fault.ErrorId AND 16#0002) <> 16#0000) OR PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.InputModuleFault;
      
      // Surveillance Kobold descente normale (hors FB_DiveSearch)
      // : signal HwIn.Machine.M1_M2_KoboldBottomTouch_DI (mÃªme que instDiveSearch Â§1).
      KoboldAutoStopRiseEdge(CLK := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Machine.M1_M2_KoboldBottomTouch_DI);
      KoboldAutoStopFallEdge(CLK := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Machine.M1_M2_KoboldBottomTouch_DI);
      
      // LevÃ©e du verrou au neutre du joystick/boutons ou si toggle dÃ©sactivÃ©
      IF PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Joystick.AtNeutralXY OR NOT GVL_IHM.Commun.Cfg.TglEnableKoboldAutoStopDescent THEN
          KoboldImmersionConfirmed := FALSE;
          KoboldBottomTouchLatched := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      
      // CoupledUserRequestActive requis : cette surveillance ne s'arme qu'en pilotage
      // COUPLÃ‰ (Select=0), pas en pilotage unitaire M1 (oÃ¹ CoupledUserRequestDirection reflÃ¨te
      // quand mÃªme l'axe joystick brut).
      // Qualification immersion : front montant Kobold dans la fenÃªtre [ImmersionLower_M..ImmersionUpper_M]
      IF GVL_IHM.Commun.Cfg.TglEnableKoboldAutoStopDescent
         AND CoupledUserRequestActive
         AND (CoupledUserRequestDirection = -1)
         AND _BucketState.IsOpen
         AND KoboldAutoStopRiseEdge.Q THEN
          IF (PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM <= _DredgingAssistCfgPersist.ImmersionUpper_M)
             AND (PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM >= _DredgingAssistCfgPersist.ImmersionLower_M)
             AND (PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.CablePosM <= _DredgingAssistCfgPersist.ImmersionUpper_M)
             AND (PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.CablePosM >= _DredgingAssistCfgPersist.ImmersionLower_M) THEN
              KoboldImmersionConfirmed := TRUE;
          END_IF;
      END_IF;
      
      // DÃ©tection fond : front descendant Kobold APRÃˆS immersion confirmÃ©e
      IF KoboldAutoStopFallEdge.Q AND KoboldImmersionConfirmed THEN
          KoboldBottomTouchLatched := TRUE;
          KoboldImmersionConfirmed := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      
      // Autorisation directe et explicite issue de PRG_03 (DiveSearch / Cycle)
      DescendPermitDiveBucketOpen := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.ReqBucket.DescendPermitDiveBucketOpen;
      
      // Le bypass arrÃªte aussi la descente instantanÃ©ment, mÃªme doctrine que le mÃ©canisme
      // KoboldBottomTouchLatched.
      // Mode "pilotage unitaire M2 sÃ©curisÃ©"
      // (SelJoystickWinch=2 + toggle IHM). Ne passe PAS par instBucket (pas de CloseReq/OpenReq
      // mÃ©morisÃ©, jogging libre) -- bornes directes ouvert/fermÃ© (mÃªmes offsets que FB_Bucket,
      // relatifs Ã  la position rÃ©elle de M1) + palier 1 (voir instWinchM2 Â§6 plus bas).
      ManualBucketLimitsActive := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bucket.Cmd.TglManualBucketLimits
          AND (PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.JoystickWinchSelectArbitrated = 2);
      
      ProcessPermitM1_Descend := NOT (KoboldBottomTouchLatched OR BypassKoboldBottomTouched) AND DescendPermitDiveBucketOpen;
      // Ce chemin (pilotage
      // unitaire M2, hors instBucket) applique l'anticipation d'inertie OpenAnticipationM/CloseAnticipationM
      // (mÃªmes que FB_Bucket) pour couvrir aussi le jog unitaire.
      ProcessPermitM2_Descend := NOT (KoboldBottomTouchLatched OR BypassKoboldBottomTouched) AND DescendPermitDiveBucketOpen
          AND NOT (ManualBucketLimitsActive AND (PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.CablePosM <= (PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM + _BucketCfgPersist.Config.OffsetOpenM + _BucketCfgPersist.Config.OpenAnticipationM)));
      
      M2_LimitShift := SEL(_BucketState.IsClosed OR instBucket.CloseReq OR (PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.JoystickWinchSelectArbitrated = 2),
                            0.0,
                            (PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM + _BucketCfgPersist.Config.OffsetCloseM + 0.5)
                            - _CommunCfgPersist.CfgCableLimitAscent_M);
      
      // FB_Safety_Winch M1/M2.
      // InstanciÃ© avant instWinchM1/M2 : MovementCommanded lit RelayFwd/RelayRev du scan prÃ©cÃ©dent
      // (mÃªme lag 1 scan acceptÃ© que M4/Translation, jamais sur Reset/SafeStop/PowerCutOff/sortie finale).
      instSafetyWinchM1(
          Enable                 := (PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode <> E_Mode.DISABLE) AND NOT PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.InhibitM1,
          Reset                  := PRG_07_Supervision.FaultMachineReset_IHM,
          PowerContactorEngaged  := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Machine.PowerContactorEngaged_DI,
          Mode                   := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode,
          SyncEnable             := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.SyncEnable,
          JoystickOnline         := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Network.Joystick.Online,
          JoystickOperational    := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Network.Joystick.Operational,
          HeartbeatIhmOk         := GVL_IHM.Commun.HeartbeatIhmOk,
          EncoderAvailable       := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM1.Measurement.EncoderAvailable,
          EncoderFaultBypass     := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.EncoderFault,
          ThermalFeedback        := NOT PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M1_ThermalOk_DI,
          BrakeThermalFeedback   := NOT PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Machine.M1_M2_M3_BrakeThermalOk_DI,
          SlackCableDetected     := NOT PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M2_TensionedCable_DI,
          PhaseRotationOk        := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Machine.PhaseRotationOk_DI,
          TopPositionSensor      := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M1M2_TopPositionFree_DI,
          InReferencingMode      := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM1.Measurement.HomingLifecycle.Busy,
          CablePosM              := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM,
          CfgCableLimitDescentM  := _WinchM1CfgPersist.CfgCableLimitDescent_M,
          LimitLegalReached      := GVL_IHM.Commun.LimitLegalReached,
          Direction              := M1LogicRequestDirection,
          MovementCommanded      := instWinchM1.RelayFwd OR instWinchM1.RelayRev,
          Homed                  := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM1.Homed,
          HomingSuspect          := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM1.HomingSuspect,
          TopLimitM              := _CommunCfgPersist.CfgCableLimitAscent_M,
          FwdRevSpeedFeedbackOff := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M1_ContactorsReleased_DI,
          BrakeFeedback          := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M1_BrakeIsOpen_DI,
          JoystickYNeutral       := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.JoystickYNeutral,
          BenneHoldStillActive   := instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy,
          ExpectedOtherWinchPosM := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.CablePosM - instBucket.ActiveOffsetM,
          BenneBusy              := instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy,
          OtherWinchInhibited    := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.InhibitM2,
          MeasuredSpeedMps       := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.Speed_Mps,
          MeasuredSpeedSignedMps := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.SignedSpeed_Mps,
          MeasuredSpeedValid     := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.SpeedValid,
          BypassGlobal           := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.Global,
          BypassSafety           := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.Safety,
          BypassProcess          := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.Process,
          // OR avec le bypass commun (Commun.Bypass) -- leve la
          // protection sur les 2 treuils simultanement pour le pilotage "both", sans retirer le
          // bypass individuel pour le pilotage a l'unite.
          BypassTopLimitSwitch   := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.TopLimitSwitch OR GVL_IHM.Commun.Bypass.TopLimitSwitch,
          BypassTopLimitSoftware := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.TopLimitSoftware OR GVL_IHM.Commun.Bypass.TopLimitSoftware,
          BypassCableLimitSwitch := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.CableLimitSwitch OR GVL_IHM.Commun.Bypass.CableLimitSwitch,
          BypassLimitLegal       := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.LimitLegal OR GVL_IHM.Commun.Bypass.LimitLegal,
          BypassOperatorComm     := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.OperatorComm,
          BypassPhaseRotation    := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.PhaseRotation,
          BypassBrakeThermal     := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.BrakeThermal,
          BypassMotorThermal     := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.MotorThermal,
          BypassMecaA            := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.MecaA,
          BypassMecaB            := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.MecaB,
          BypassMecaC            := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.MecaC,
          BypassMecaD            := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.MecaD,
          BypassMecaE            := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.MecaE
      );
      
      instSafetyWinchM2(
          Enable                 := (PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode <> E_Mode.DISABLE) AND NOT PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.InhibitM2,
          Reset                  := PRG_07_Supervision.FaultMachineReset_IHM,
          PowerContactorEngaged  := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Machine.PowerContactorEngaged_DI,
          Mode                   := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode,
          SyncEnable             := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.SyncEnable,
          JoystickOnline         := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Network.Joystick.Online,
          JoystickOperational    := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Network.Joystick.Operational,
          HeartbeatIhmOk         := GVL_IHM.Commun.HeartbeatIhmOk,
          EncoderAvailable       := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM2.Measurement.EncoderAvailable,
          EncoderFaultBypass     := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.EncoderFault,
          ThermalFeedback        := NOT PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M2_ThermalOk_DI,
          BrakeThermalFeedback   := NOT PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Machine.M1_M2_M3_BrakeThermalOk_DI,
          SlackCableDetected     := NOT PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M2_TensionedCable_DI,
          PhaseRotationOk        := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Machine.PhaseRotationOk_DI,
          TopPositionSensor      := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M1M2_TopPositionFree_DI,
          InReferencingMode      := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM2.Measurement.HomingLifecycle.Busy,
          CablePosM              := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.CablePosM,
          CfgCableLimitDescentM  := _WinchM2CfgPersist.CfgCableLimitDescent_M,
          LimitLegalReached      := GVL_IHM.Commun.LimitLegalReached,
          Direction              := M2LogicRequestDirection,
          MovementCommanded      := instWinchM2.RelayFwd OR instWinchM2.RelayRev,
          Homed                  := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM2.Homed,
          HomingSuspect          := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM2.HomingSuspect,
          TopLimitM              := _CommunCfgPersist.CfgCableLimitAscent_M + M2_LimitShift,
          FwdRevSpeedFeedbackOff := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M2_ContactorsReleased_DI,
          BrakeFeedback          := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M2_BrakeIsOpen_DI,
          JoystickYNeutral       := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.JoystickYNeutral,
          BenneHoldStillActive   := FALSE,
          ExpectedOtherWinchPosM := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM + instBucket.ActiveOffsetM,
          BenneBusy              := instBucket.Lifecycle.Busy,
          OtherWinchInhibited    := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.InhibitM1,
          MeasuredSpeedMps       := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.Speed_Mps,
          MeasuredSpeedSignedMps := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.SignedSpeed_Mps,
          MeasuredSpeedValid     := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.SpeedValid,
          BypassGlobal           := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.Global,
          BypassSafety           := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.Safety,
          BypassProcess          := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.Process,
          // OR avec le bypass commun (Commun.Bypass) -- voir M1 ci-dessus
          BypassTopLimitSwitch   := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.TopLimitSwitch OR GVL_IHM.Commun.Bypass.TopLimitSwitch,
          BypassTopLimitSoftware := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.TopLimitSoftware OR GVL_IHM.Commun.Bypass.TopLimitSoftware,
          BypassCableLimitSwitch := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.CableLimitSwitch OR GVL_IHM.Commun.Bypass.CableLimitSwitch,
          BypassLimitLegal       := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.LimitLegal OR GVL_IHM.Commun.Bypass.LimitLegal,
          BypassOperatorComm     := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.OperatorComm,
          BypassPhaseRotation    := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.PhaseRotation,
          BypassBrakeThermal     := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.BrakeThermal,
          BypassMotorThermal     := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.MotorThermal,
          BypassMecaA            := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.MecaA,
          BypassMecaB            := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.MecaB,
          BypassMecaC            := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.MecaC,
          BypassMecaD            := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.MecaD,
          BypassMecaE            := GVL_IHM.M2TreuilBenne.Bypass.MecaE
      );
      
      SafeStopM1_Raw := SafeStopM1_Raw OR instSafetyWinchM1.SafeStop;
      SafeStopM2_Raw := SafeStopM2_Raw OR instSafetyWinchM2.SafeStop;
      // SafetyPermit = sorties FB_Safety_Winch (safety pure)
      SafetyPermitM1_Descend := instSafetyWinchM1.DescendPermit;
      SafetyPermitM2_Descend := instSafetyWinchM2.DescendPermit;
      SafetyPermitM1_Ascent  := instSafetyWinchM1.AscentPermit;
      SafetyPermitM2_Ascent  := instSafetyWinchM2.AscentPermit;
      // ProcessAndSafetyPermit = Safety AND Process (ex _Raw)
      ProcessAndSafetyPermitM1_Descend := ProcessPermitM1_Descend AND SafetyPermitM1_Descend;
      ProcessAndSafetyPermitM2_Descend := ProcessPermitM2_Descend AND SafetyPermitM2_Descend;
      
      // Mode "vidage Ã  la trÃ©mie" : descente M1 ET M2 interdite tant
      // que M3 n'est pas Ã  P1 (travail) ou en position Maintenance -- verrouille la sÃ©quence
      // descente-treuil / translation pour se rapprocher d'un enchaÃ®nement automatique sÃ»r.
      // DÃ©cision et calcul centralisÃ©s dans PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.SequenceState.DumpAtTremieDescentLocked
      IF PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.SequenceState.DumpAtTremieDescentLocked THEN
          ProcessAndSafetyPermitM1_Descend := FALSE;
          ProcessAndSafetyPermitM2_Descend := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      ProcessAndSafetyPermitM1_Ascent := SafetyPermitM1_Ascent;
      ProcessAndSafetyPermitM2_Ascent := SafetyPermitM2_Ascent
          // MÃªme anticipation que ProcessPermitM2_Descend ci-dessus.
          AND NOT (ManualBucketLimitsActive AND (PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M2.CablePosM >= (PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM + _BucketCfgPersist.Config.OffsetCloseM - _BucketCfgPersist.Config.CloseAnticipationM)));
      
      SafeStopM1_Active := SafeStopM1_Raw OR (instWinchSync.SyncActive AND SafeStopM2_Raw);
      SafeStopM2_Active := SafeStopM2_Raw OR (instWinchSync.SyncActive AND SafeStopM1_Raw);
      // EffectivePermit = ProcessAndSafetyPermit combine au couplage synchro (anti-tÃ©lescopage)
      EffectivePermitM1_Descend := ProcessAndSafetyPermitM1_Descend AND (NOT instWinchSync.SyncActive OR ProcessAndSafetyPermitM2_Descend);
      EffectivePermitM2_Descend := ProcessAndSafetyPermitM2_Descend AND (NOT instWinchSync.SyncActive OR ProcessAndSafetyPermitM1_Descend);
      EffectivePermitM1_Ascent  := ProcessAndSafetyPermitM1_Ascent  AND (NOT instWinchSync.SyncActive OR ProcessAndSafetyPermitM2_Ascent);
      EffectivePermitM2_Ascent  := ProcessAndSafetyPermitM2_Ascent  AND (NOT instWinchSync.SyncActive OR ProcessAndSafetyPermitM1_Ascent);
      
      
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§6 Execution treuils M1/M2"}
      // === âš™ï¸ Â§6 EXÃ‰CUTION FB_Winch (M1 & M2) ===
      
      instWinchM1(
          Enable                  := (PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode <> E_Mode.DISABLE) AND NOT PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.InhibitM1,
          Reset                   := PRG_07_Supervision.FaultMachineReset_IHM,
          PowerContactorEngaged   := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Machine.PowerContactorEngaged_DI,
          Mode                    := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode,
          StartStop               := M1LogicRequestStartStop,
          SafeStop                := SafeStopM1_Active,
          DescendPermit           := EffectivePermitM1_Descend,
          AscentPermit            := EffectivePermitM1_Ascent,
          Direction               := M1LogicRequestDirection,
          SpeedTgt_Pct            := M1LogicRequestSpeedCmd_Pct,
          SpeedStepTable          := _WinchSpeedStepTable,
          CfgMaxStepDescente      := SEL(instWinchSync.SyncDeviationWarn, EffectiveMaxStepDescente, 1),
          // Plafonnement au Palier 1 pour mou de cÃ¢ble, synchro dÃ©gradÃ©e et benne non fermÃ©e
          MaxStepAscent           := SEL(PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.ReqProgram.ReqBucket.ForceMinSpeedStep OR ControlAscentActive OR instWinchSync.SyncDeviationWarn OR BucketNotClosedAscentStep1 OR SlackCableAscentStep1, EffectiveMaxStepAscent, 1),
          MeasuredSpeedBand       := 0,
          SpeedGuardEnable        := SpeedGuardEnableM1,
          SpeedGuardReady         := NOT instWinchSync.Fault.Error,
          HomingApproachActive    := PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.HomingApproachEnable,
          FwdRevSpeedFeedbackOff  := PRG_02_Acquisition.HwIn.Winch.M1_ContactorsReleased_DI,
          BypassContactorCheck    := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.Global OR GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.ContactorFeedback,
          Homed                   := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM1.Homed,
          HomingSuspect           := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.EncoderM1.HomingSuspect,
          CablePosM               := PRG_02_Acquisition.Data.Encoders.M1.CablePosM,
          TopLimitM               := _CommunCfgPersist.CfgCableLimitAscent_M,
          BottomLimitM            := BottomLimitM1_Active,
          CfgSlowdownDistanceM    := _CommunCfgPersist.WinchSlowdownDistance_M,
          CfgSlowdownMaxStep      := _CommunCfgPersist.WinchSlowdownMaxStep,
          BypassGlobal            := GVL_IHM.M1TreuilRetenue.Bypass.Global
      );
      
      instWinchM2(
          Enable                  := (PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.Mode <> E_Mode.DISABLE) AND NOT PRG_03_Modes_Cycle.Data.Auth.InhibitM2,
          Reset                   := PRG_07_Supervision.FaultMachineReset_IHM,

      Ready := Enable AND NOT Fault.Latched;

      IF FirstCycle THEN
          FirstCycle := FALSE;
          IF NOT BucketState.IsOpen AND NOT BucketState.IsClosed THEN
              BucketState.StateIncoherent := TRUE;
          END_IF;
      END_IF;
      
      ConfirmOpenEdge(CLK := ConfirmOpenPosition);
      IF ConfirmOpenEdge.Q AND ((Mode = E_Mode.MAINT_N1) OR (Mode = E_Mode.MAINT_N2)) AND NOT Lifecycle.Busy THEN
          BucketState.IsOpen := TRUE;
          BucketState.IsClosed := FALSE;
          BucketState.LastPosM2Open := CablePosM2;
          BucketState.StateIncoherent := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      
      ConfirmCloseEdge(CLK := ConfirmClosePosition);
      IF ConfirmCloseEdge.Q AND ((Mode = E_Mode.MAINT_N1) OR (Mode = E_Mode.MAINT_N2)) AND NOT Lifecycle.Busy THEN
          BucketState.IsOpen := FALSE;
          BucketState.IsClosed := TRUE;
          BucketState.LastPosM2Close := CablePosM2;
          BucketState.StateIncoherent := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§4 SÃ©quencement mouvement benne"}
      SevereError := Fault.Error;
      
      IF SevereError THEN
          M2_StartStop := FALSE;
          M2_Direction := 0;
          M2_ForceSlowSpeed := FALSE;
          CloseReq := FALSE;
          OpenReq := FALSE;
          Lifecycle.Busy := FALSE;
          Lifecycle.Done := FALSE;
      ELSE
          // Prise en compte des demandes IHM â€” anti-traversÃ©e (TC-P10-025) :

          ELSIF CmdClose_IHM AND NOT Lifecycle.Busy AND NOT M1_Busy AND NOT M2_Busy THEN
              CloseReq := TRUE;
              OpenReq := FALSE;
          END_IF;

          Config.CoherenceLimitM := 5.0;
          Config.CloseAnticipationM := 0.2;
          Config.OpenAnticipationM := 0.2;

          (* Scan 0 : Enable=FALSE -> Neutralisation standard *)
          FB(Enable := FALSE, Reset := FALSE, PowerContactorEngaged := TRUE,

          ASSERT_TRUE(FB.Ready, 'Enable=TRUE -> Ready=TRUE (nominal)');
      
          ADVANCE_TIME(10000000);
      
          (* Scan 2 : Enable=FALSE -> Re-neutralisation *)
          FB(Enable := FALSE, Reset := FALSE, PowerContactorEngaged := TRUE,
             HomedM1 := TRUE, HomedM2 := TRUE,
             Config := Config, BucketState := BucketState);
          ASSERT_FALSE(FB.Ready, 'Coupure -> Ready retombe a FALSE');

Je poursuis la calibration correctement : chaque scan de convergence doit répéter la configuration, le mode, l’homme-mort et la demande.

          Contactor1 := FALSE; Contactor2 := FALSE; Contactor3 := FALSE; Contactor4 := FALSE;
          RequestedStep := 0;
          StepNumber := 0;
          CommandedDirection := 0;
          DirectionChangePending := FALSE;
          BusinessStepDelay(IN := FALSE);
          DirectionChangeDelay(IN := FALSE);
          TonContactorsDropped(IN := FALSE);
          ContactorsCheck.Command := FALSE;
          ContactorsCheck.Feedback := NOT FwdRevSpeedFeedbackOff;
          InTopSlowdownZone := FALSE;
          InBottomSlowdownZone := FALSE;
          Ready := FALSE;
          RETURN;
      END_IF;
      
      Ready := Enable AND NOT Fault.Latched;
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§3 Premier scan et temps de cycle"}
      IF NOT FirstScanDone THEN
          FirstScanDone := TRUE;
          CommandedDirection := Direction;
      END_IF;
      
      CycleTimeCalc();
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§4 Permis et zones de ralentissement"}
      EffectiveSafeStop := SafeStop OR (Direction > 0 AND NOT AscentPermit) OR (Direction < 0 AND NOT DescendPermit);
      
      InTopSlowdownZone := Homed AND NOT HomingSuspect AND (CablePosM >= (TopLimitM - CfgSlowdownDistanceM));
      InBottomSlowdownZone := Homed AND NOT HomingSuspect AND (CablePosM <= (BottomLimitM + CfgSlowdownDistanceM));
      
      IF Direction > 0 THEN
          ActiveMaxStep := MaxStepAscent;
          IF InTopSlowdownZone THEN
              ActiveMaxStep := MIN(ActiveMaxStep, CfgSlowdownMaxStep);
          END_IF;
      ELSIF Direction < 0 THEN
          ActiveMaxStep := CfgMaxStepDescente;
          IF InBottomSlowdownZone THEN
              ActiveMaxStep := MIN(ActiveMaxStep, CfgSlowdownMaxStep);
          END_IF;
      ELSE
          ActiveMaxStep := MaxStepAscent;
      END_IF;
      
      IF HomingApproachActive THEN
          ActiveMaxStep := 1;
      END_IF;
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§5 Interlock direction"}
      IF Direction > 0 THEN
          EffectiveDirectionInterlockDelay := DirectionInterlockDelayAscent;
      ELSE
          EffectiveDirectionInterlockDelay := DirectionInterlockDelayDescent;
      END_IF;
      
      DirectionChangeDelay(
          IN := (Direction <> 0) AND (Direction <> CommandedDirection) AND (StepNumber = 0) AND FwdRevSpeedFeedbackOff,
          PT := EffectiveDirectionInterlockDelay
      );
      DirectionChangeDelayElapsed := DirectionChangeDelay.ET;
      
      IF (CommandedDirection = 0) AND (Direction <> 0) THEN
          CommandedDirection := Direction;
          DirectionChangePending := FALSE;
      ELSIF DirectionChangeDelay.Q THEN
          CommandedDirection := Direction;
          DirectionChangePending := FALSE;
      ELSIF (Direction <> 0) AND (Direction <> CommandedDirection) THEN
          DirectionChangePending := TRUE;
      ELSE
          DirectionChangePending := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      
      IF Direction = 0 THEN
          CommandedDirection := 0;
          DirectionChangePending := FALSE;
      END_IF;
      {endregion}
      
      {region "Â§6 Paliers vitesse et contacteurs"}
      IF DirectionChangePending OR (Direction = 0) OR EffectiveSafeStop OR NOT StartStop THEN
          RampTargetPct := 0.0;
      ELSE
          RampTargetPct := LIMIT(0.0, SpeedTgt_Pct, 100.0);
      END_IF;
      
      SpeedStep(
          Enable := (RampTargetPct > 0.1),
          SpeedTgt_Pct := RampTargetPct,
          Table := SpeedStepTable,
          HystMargin := SpeedStepHystMargin,
